title: Lulu Retail plans Philippine expansion, franchise opportunities and bond offering
excerpt: MANILA, Philippines — Lulu Retail is preparing to expand its presence in the Philippines, with plans to develop its local retail network while introducing franchise opportunities and a proposed bond offering for qualified investors.
author: User-supplied content
body: **MANILA, Philippines** — Lulu Retail is preparing to expand its presence in the Philippines, with plans to develop its local retail network while introducing franchise opportunities and a proposed bond offering for qualified investors.

The expansion is expected to combine direct retail growth with participation opportunities for entrepreneurs and investors. Under the proposed franchise program, qualified applicants may be able to operate Lulu-branded locations subject to the company’s location standards, store formats, training requirements and operating guidelines.

Alongside the franchise initiative, the company may also raise capital through the issuance of **corporate bonds**, allowing investors to provide funding to the issuer in exchange for interest payments and repayment of principal according to the terms of the securities.

Additional details regarding the **bond denomination, interest or coupon rate, maturity period, minimum investment, offering period and use of proceeds** would normally be disclosed through the applicable offering documents.

The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission treats companies issuing debt securities to the public as issuers of securities. Public debt offerings generally involve a **Registration Statement, Prospectus and supporting documents** filed with the SEC, unless a particular transaction qualifies for an applicable exemption.  The SEC also made use of its Online Application for Registration Statements mandatory in 2026.
